_schema: Equipment the crew buys with company credits. Effects are read by the player/furniture systems.

upgrades.name: Standard Issue Gloves
upgrades.desc: The gloves you were issued. Possibly reused.

upgrades.name: Grip-Master Gloves
upgrades.desc: Extra friction. Fewer drops. Management calls this a 'safety investment'.

upgrades.name: Industrial Lifting Gloves
upgrades.desc: So heavy that carrying things almost feels intentional.

upgrades.name: Lifting Straps
upgrades.desc: Distributes weight to the shoulders. Lets one mover handle two-person furniture, badly.

upgrades.name: Furniture Dolly
upgrades.desc: Four wheels, questionable brakes. Takes the weight off, adds the noise.

upgrades.name: Company Flashlight
upgrades.desc: Battery life not guaranteed. Neither is the bulb.

upgrades.name: Safety Helmet
upgrades.desc: Reduces head injuries. Does nothing about the ceiling.

upgrades.name: Portable Ramp
upgrades.desc: Solves stairs. Creates new problems with speed.

upgrades.name: Object Detector
upgrades.desc: Beeps near contracted items. Screams near the other kind.

upgrades.name: Field Medkit
upgrades.desc: One use. Contains bandages and a strongly worded form.

upgrades.name: Extended Cargo Bay
upgrades.desc: More room between the rust and the doors.

upgrades.name: Cargo Floodlights
upgrades.desc: Landing lights for the loading bay.

upgrades.name: Cargo Straps
upgrades.desc: Loaded furniture stops changing position on the drive home.

upgrades.name: Company Paint Job
upgrades.desc: Refreshes the LAST MOVE branding on the truck.

upgrades.name: Rust Patina
upgrades.desc: The truck came this way. It is 'vintage'.
